topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't shake the thought that I should have seen it coming, the outlines of that patent, a dark shadow over the plans I thought were uniquely mine. The paperwork, the dates, all lined up in a way that suggests someone was always one step ahead. I wonder if there was a sign, a clue I overlooked, in the quiet corners of the research, or in the whispered conversations that seemed unimportant at the time. It’s strange, how the mind can find endless paths to second-guess, to wander through the what-ifs and the could-have-beens. All I can do now is step back, to let the inventor who got there first take their place, and quietly return to the drawing board, hoping this time, the future will be more mine to shape.
